name: Snowyowl
introduce:
HR-300X Snowyowl
A Medium repair and support ST developed under the leadership of Horizon, currently deployed in limited numbers for combat testing and data collection.
To effectively support high-intensity ST operations and align its product line with contemporary combat systems, Horizon established the development plan for the HR-300X multifunctional support ST, culminating in the prototype codenamed "Snowyowl." For this model, Horizon shifted focus from precision and burst firepower to armor load, maneuverability, and tactical data links, equipping it with fifteen sets of algorithm accessories for real-time optimal configuration. This series of designs endows the unit with exceptional continuous combat capabilities, while also enabling real-time battlefield monitoring to provide efficient repair and support to multiple ally tactical units.

20524.name: Sentinel Unit
20524.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, applies <buf ID=7100305>[DMG UP III]</buf> to all repaired targets, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. If the target already has a <buf ID=7100300>[DMG UP]</buf> effect, increases the effect by <color=#F74848>1</color> level, up to a maximum of <buf ID=7100309>[DMG UP V]</buf>.

30428.name: Sustain Mod
30428.SpecificEffects:
When performing active repairs, Repair AMT increases by <color=#F74848>12%</color>, with an additional increase of <color=#F74848>24%</color> to the part with the lowest HP.
This unit and the first summoned unit will not be destroyed when taking fatal damage. After battle, repairs all destroyed parts and restores <color=#F74848>30%</color> of Max HP to all allies within a <color=#F74848>2</color>-block range. This effect can be activated <color=#F74848>1</color> time per deployment.
